brief: A thick white waveform pulses rhythmically against a dark gray background, simulating a heartbeat that occasionally skips or accelerates. A deep red vertical line traces the path of this pattern across the screen from left to right. When the mouse clicks, the entire EKG rhythm resets instantly, and the red trace begins anew at the far left edge while the background hue shifts slightly.
